prayerExcerpt.en-US: We may love our neighbor in deeds and in truth.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Amemos o próximo por obras e na verdade.

meta.face: Peter Claver (left): a lean man of about fifty with a TRIANGULAR face — a broad forehead and temples tapering past hollow cheeks to a narrow, pointed chin; a long, prominent aquiline nose, deep-set dark eyes under thin, straight dark brows, a thin-lipped, gentle mouth; clean-shaven, short black hair receding at the temples, eyes lowered to the man with compassion. The African man (right): about twenty-five, with deep dark-brown skin and a smooth OVAL face — high, rounded cheekbones, a broad, flat-bridged nose, large dark eyes under full brows, full lips set in a calm, grave expression, a firm chin; short, tightly curled black hair, clean-shaven, and a steady, self-possessed gaze toward the priest.
meta.basis: The seventeenth-century Cartagena portrait type (Wikipedia lead image) shows a gaunt, clean-shaven Jesuit; his ministry was meeting the slave ships with water, food and medicine, most of the captives from Angola and West Africa. The companion is drawn upright and equal, not kneeling.
